ns2:section.sectionText: 1 Credit hour PREPARING FUTURE FACULTY. This course is for Chemistry Graduate Students in their 2nd year or above. This course will teach essential skills to obtaining and succeeding in an independent academic career. Topics will include: deciding whether academics is right for you, mechanics of a job search and interview skills, writing successful independent research proposals, setting up a research program and managing a group, teaching your first class, and getting tenure. Different types of academic careers will be examined and an effort will be made to demystify the academy.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Chemistry major(s). Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.
